title: Radiology reporting
seo_description: Radiology reporting software for imaging centers: templates for ultrasound, X-ray, CT, and MRI, automatic drafts, digital signature, and one patient case with lab results.

fields.hero_title: Radiology reporting for ultrasound, X-ray, CT, and MRI
fields.hero_lead: Report imaging studies from ready templates, next to the lab results for the same patient. Drafts save automatically, and doctors sign and send in one click.
fields.features:
Template library for each modality
Drafts saved automatically
Structured findings and impression
Preview before release
Digital signature, then send
Lab and imaging on the same patient case

steps.title: Pick a template
steps.text: Choose the template for the study: ultrasound, X-ray, CT, or MRI.

steps.title: Complete the findings
steps.text: Fill in structured findings and the impression; the draft saves as you go.

steps.title: Sign and send
steps.text: Preview, sign, and deliver the report to the patient and the referring doctor.

fields.cta_title: See radiology reporting with your own setup
fields.cta_text: Bring your test menu and price list. We will show you a patient case from registration to signed report, configured the way your team works.
